drawer.busyWaitNote: Send is off until the answer is done, as before.

drawer.mathNote: draw equations in answers as formulas (works offline)

drawer.savedHere: Saved here, but not for other apps
drawer.savedOwn: Other apps use their own settings again.
drawer.savedShared: Other apps (omp, API clients) use these settings from their next request.
drawer.shareNote: omp and other API clients get these settings for anything they do not set themselves
drawer.temperatureNote: 0 = always the most likely word (exact, repeatable)

Run this code with scripts?

ws.autoDecide: Checking whether a web search helps…
ws.autoText: I'll decide when a web search helps. Chats stay on this PC; queries may go out.
ws.globeTitle: Web search: look the question up before answering
ws.jinaNote: Privacy: with the Jina reader the page URLs go through r.jina.ai - a third party sees which pages are read.
ws.limNote: off = whole pages go in; the server still caps the total at the model's context
ws.methodNote: Model decides: the model calls a web search when it helps (recommended). Simple check: a fixed keyword test, for models that cannot call tools reliably.
ws.offByDefault: Web search is off by default – when on, only the search query goes out.
ws.onJinaAlways: Every page is read through r.jina.ai - a third party sees those URLs.
ws.onJinaFallback: Pages that fail to read directly go through r.jina.ai - a third party sees those URLs.
ws.onLanCaution: Caution: this server is reachable beyond this PC (bound to 0.0.0.0 or a LAN address) - queries and engine API keys cross your network in plain HTTP, and without an api_key any device on it can use this search.
ws.onText: Search queries now go to {engine}. Chats still stay on this PC.
ws.optNote: Refines your question into a focused search query before searching (uses the local model)
ws.optNoteOff: Searches the exact wording as typed
ws.readNote: fetches the top pages in full, not just the snippets
ws.readerAlways: Jina always (best readability on JavaScript-heavy pages)
ws.readerFallback: Jina fallback (r.jina.ai reads a page only when direct reading fails)
ws.readerOff: Direct only (default - pages are read on this PC)
ws.searchNote: look the question up before answering; the composer's globe switches it too
ws.wholePages: whole pages, capped by model context
